d.summary: Windows converts UTF-16 to the ANSI code page with Best-Fit mappings: fullwidth quote U+FF02 becomes ", yen U+00A5 becomes \, soft hyphen becomes -. CVE-2024-29059.

2024-145.label: Shared Storage worklet queue and termination channels

d.title: Shared Storage Return Times Outside of Worklet Appear to Be Dependent on Activity in Worklet
d.summary: Demonstrates that Shared Storage writes inside a worklet alter completion times of writes issued outside it. Histograms expose otherwise hidden worklet activity through contention in the storage API, motivating discussion of immediate resolution, rate limits, and execution limits.

d.title: Leaking more than log_2(|URLs|) bits of data with the selectURL gate
d.summary: Shared Storage worklets delay selected-URL requests according to stored values, leaking information through server-observed timing even when a single URL incurs zero budget cost. Later comments demonstrate conditional worklet crashes as a request-presence channel and discuss process isolation.

2024-146.label: Account Takeover due to DNS Rebinding

d.title: Account Takeover due to DNS Rebinding
d.summary: Examines a login-token handoff that continues to trust a custom domain after its DNS destination changes. The owner verifies the domain, obtains TLS credentials and repoints its records; a subsequent authentication flow sends a redeemable token to the owner’s server. The case includes a DNS-switching helper for testing the lifetime of domain trust.

d.title: DNS-Switching Helper for Custom-Domain Authentication Testing
d.summary: Provides a small helper for changing a custom-domain CNAME and serving a link used in the accompanying login-token experiment. The source supports testing whether an application continues to send authentication state to a formerly verified destination after its DNS record changes; propagation and token redemption depend on the surrounding setup.

d.title: Hacking Apple - SQL Injection to Remote Code Execution — ProjectDiscovery Blog
d.summary: Describes custom analysis of CFML applications to identify SQL injection sinks and trace their reachability. The Apple travel-portal case demonstrates unauthorized account access; execution through scheduled tasks was tested locally and remained a theoretical escalation on Apple’s deployment.

d.title: GitHub Enterprise SAML Authentication Bypass (CVE-2024-4985 / CVE-2024-9487) — ProjectDiscovery Blog
d.summary: Explains GitHub Enterprise SAML authentication failures caused by differences between the assertions validated for signatures and those consumed after decryption. Reconstructs the vulnerable processing order and a subsequent bypass, with disclosure context acknowledging an earlier private report.

d.title: Android web attack surface
d.summary: Maps Android browser-to-app intent routes that lose browser origin, activation or launch restrictions. Firebase, market and augmented-reality handlers provide concrete relay and WebView examples. The account distinguishes intended native facilities exposed through unsafe routing from browser bugs, and states prerequisites for privileged bridge access.
